entries.title: Stormwind City
entries.text: Stormwind is the human capital north of Elwynn Forest and a major Alliance center for trade, training, and travel.

entries.title: Orgrimmar
entries.text: Orgrimmar is the orc capital in Durotar and a major Horde center for trade, training, and travel.

entries.title: The Deadmines
entries.text: The Deadmines lie beneath Westfall and serve as the Defias Brotherhood's stronghold, culminating in a confrontation with Edwin VanCleef.

entries.title: Wailing Caverns
entries.text: Wailing Caverns is a twisting Barrens dungeon where the Druids of the Fang and altered wildlife dwell.

entries.title: Scarlet Monastery
entries.text: The Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades is a heavily defended stronghold of the fanatical Scarlet Crusade.

entries.title: Blackrock Depths
entries.text: Blackrock Depths is the vast Dark Iron city beneath Blackrock Mountain, filled with prisons, forges, taverns, and imperial halls.

entries.title: Molten Core
entries.text: Molten Core is a fiery raid beneath Blackrock Mountain where Ragnaros and his elemental servants hold power.

entries.title: Onyxia's Lair
entries.text: Onyxia's Lair is hidden in Dustwallow Marsh and is home to the black dragon Onyxia and her brood.

entries.title: Stranglethorn Vale
entries.text: Stranglethorn Vale is a contested jungle of ancient Gurubashi ruins, dangerous wildlife, and the neutral port of Booty Bay.

entries.title: Professions
entries.text: Gathering professions supply materials, while crafting professions turn them into equipment, consumables, and other useful goods.
